rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something refreshingly thrilling or exciting.

example.traditional: 呢套過山車真係好刺激。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 gwo3 saan1 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci3 gik1

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the thing causes excitement in people.

example.english: The atmosphere at the final is exhilarating.
example.traditional: 呢場決賽嘅氣氛令人興奮。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 kyut3 coi3 ge3 hei3 fan1 ling6 jan4 hing1 fan5

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the thrilling experience is also especially enjoyable or satisfying.

example.english: Cycling at night with the sea breeze is exhilarating.
example.traditional: 夜晚踩住單車吹住海風，真係過癮。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 caai2 zyu6 daan1 ce1 ceoi1 zyu6 hoi2 fung1 zan1 hai6 gwo3 jan5
